english.title: Use / cause / permit use of transport equipment without certification for international carriage of perishable foods
english.standardoffencewording:

transport equipment for the international carriage of perishable foodstuffs, without a certificate of compliance or affixed valid certificate plate
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7(1)(a) and (2) of the International Carriage of Perishable Foodstuffs Act 1976.

english.notes:
(i) A defence exists for this offence under section 7(3) where the person charged can prove they are the carrier for hire or reward of the perishable foodstuffs to which the charge relates and it is a term of the contract for the carriage that he does not undertake to comply or to secure compliance with the requirements of the regulation to which the charge relates.
(ii) For corporate liability see section 13 of the Act.
